analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of docs.metriport.com covered 359 pages with 100.28% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. Critical issues include 4 confirmed broken internal documentation links, 0% example reliability (no working code examples detected), and only 6.96% of pages displaying freshness metadata. API reference coverage is 80% across 349 detected API pages. SEO/geo issues affect 14.55% of pages, indicating potential discoverability problems.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage (100.28%) with 359 pages successfully examined
Strong API documentation presence with 349 API pages detected and 80% reference coverage
High overall audit confidence at 91.5% with robust link verification (95% confidence)
No repository navigation broken links; all 4 broken links are user-facing documentation
Clean crawl with zero trap URLs or excluded links
risks: Zero percent example reliability means no working code examples detected across 359 pages, severely impacting developer onboarding
4 confirmed broken internal documentation links degrade user trust and navigation experience
Only 6.96% freshness coverage leaves users unable to assess content currency on 93% of pages
14.55% SEO/geo issue rate may reduce organic discoverability and search ranking
20% API reference gap leaves portions of API undocumented or undetectable
No detection note on examples suggests systematic issue with code sample implementation or testing
Lack of last-updated timestamps prevents users from evaluating documentation reliability

prioritized_actions.action: Implement automated code example testing and validation across all documentation pages to achieve >80% example reliability
Fix all 4 confirmed broken internal documentation links immediately
Add last-updated metadata to all pages, targeting 90%+ coverage with automated git-based timestamps
Audit and resolve SEO/geo issues on the 52+ affected pages (14.55% of 359)
Close the 20% API reference gap by documenting missing endpoints or improving detection patterns

limitations: External audit cannot verify functional correctness of API documentation content or parameter accuracy
Code example execution environment and runtime dependencies are not validated; examples may fail in production contexts
Audit cannot assess documentation completeness for internal/private APIs not exposed in public documentation
User comprehension, tutorial effectiveness, and actual developer success rates are not measured
Third-party integrations, SDK documentation hosted externally, and embedded widgets are outside audit scope
